title: Equivariant module sheafification as a reflector
statement:
Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $(C,J)$ be a $\mathcal V$-small site with finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $K:C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Grp}$ be a sheaf of groups with $\mathcal V$-small values. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative unital rings on $C$ with $\mathcal V$-small values and trivial $K$-action. Let $P$ be a presheaf of $R$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] with operations $K(U)\times P(U)\to P(U)$ natural in $U$, satisfying the left group-action laws and $R(U)$-linearity in $P(U)$. Morphisms of such objects mean natural componentwise $R(U)$-linear maps commuting with the actions. Put $A=P^\#$, the ordinary module sheafification on $C$, with its unit $\eta_P:P\to A$.

There is a unique natural $K$-action on $A$ making $\eta_P$ equivariant. This action satisfies the identity, associativity, additivity and scalar-linearity laws and makes $A$ a $K$-equivariant $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every equivariant $R$-module sheaf $Q$ and every equivariant presheaf map $v:P\to Q$, there is a unique equivariant $R$-linear sheaf map $v^\#:A\to Q$ with $v^\#\eta_P=v$. These extensions define a functor from equivariant presheaves to equivariant sheaves, left adjoint to their inclusion. After forgetting the actions, the functor and its unit are ordinary module sheafification and its unit, naturally in $P$.

proof.text: Use ordinary module sheafification [lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-interface], whose underlying abelian sheafification unit is linear and locally surjective. Forgetting abelian groups preserves sheafification [lem-pc-sites-sheafification-underlying-sets], so the underlying set unit η is a J-local equivalence. Finite-product preservation [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-sets-exact] implies that id_K × η is a J-local equivalence: conjugate its image under set sheafification by the product comparison isomorphisms. This works even when K is merely a group presheaf. Maps from its codomain to a set sheaf therefore factor uniquely across this product unit [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

source.place: Tag 00WJ, lemma-sheafification-exact; Tag 00WH, proposition-sheafification-adjoint; Tag 00YR, section-sheaves-algebraic-structures. Agent extension to the internal equivariant module assertion.

proof.text: Form the natural map K × |P| → |P| given by the original action, followed by η. The bijection on maps into the sheaf |P^#| supplied by the J-local equivalence id_K × η uniquely extends it to a natural map β:K × |P^#| → |P^#| [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Its factorization equation says β(g,η(p))=η(g·p).

source.place: Tag 00WJ, lemma-sheafification-exact; Tag 00WH, proposition-sheafification-adjoint; Tag 00YR, section-sheaves-algebraic-structures. Agent extension to the internal equivariant module assertion.

proof.text: Check the group and linearity equations locally using the locally surjective module sheafification unit from [lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-interface]. For a section p of P^#, its image sieve is covering. Restrict there and choose q with η(q)=p restricted. Naturality of β and the factorization equation reduce identity, multiplication and scalar-linearity to their laws on P; η is linear. For additivity first lift p locally, then lift the restriction of the second section on a further cover. Separatedness of P^# proves each equality from these local equalities. Bundle β as a monoid hom into linear endomorphisms, obtaining LinearAction. Any natural competing action agreeing with η is equal to β by exactly the same local-preimage and separatedness argument. No commutativity of the group is used.

source.place: Tag 00WJ, lemma-sheafification-exact; Tag 00WH, proposition-sheafification-adjoint; Tag 00YR, section-sheaves-algebraic-structures. Agent extension to the internal equivariant module assertion.

proof.text: Use [lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-interface] to extend an equivariant map v:P→Q uniquely to an ordinary linear sheaf morphism w:P^#→Q. To check equivariance at p, locally lift p along η. Naturality of w and both actions identifies the restricted equivariance equation with the original equivariance of v. Separatedness of Q proves it globally. Ordinary uniqueness gives uniqueness among equivariant extensions.

source.place: Tag 00WJ, lemma-sheafification-exact; Tag 00WH, proposition-sheafification-adjoint; Tag 00YR, section-sheaves-algebraic-structures. Agent extension to the internal equivariant module assertion.

proof.text: Package each P^# with the constructed action and its equivariant unit. Precomposition with this unit is bijective on equivariant maps into any equivariant sheaf, by step 4, and natural in the target by associativity. Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointOfEquiv and Adjunction.adjunctionOfEquivLeft give the functor and adjunction. The adjunction unit is the constructed unit. The underlying objects are definitionally ordinary module sheafification. Naturality of the adjunction unit and ordinary sheafification uniqueness [lem-pc-sites-module-sheafification-interface] show that the maps are ordinary module sheafification as well. The resulting identity-component comparison is natural and preserves the unit.
